subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars` and `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars` be writable through the agent-facing Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch` tool, or should this stay limited to non-agent config persistence paths?
rationale: The fields are valid user config, but the remaining source-level mismatch is inside a model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so maintainer intent is needed before treating an allowlist expansion as the fix.

options.title: Allow only default bootstrap limits
options.body: Permit the two `agents.defaults` bootstrap limit paths through the Gateway tool with focused guard tests and real restart/config-write proof.

options.title: Keep agent writes blocked
options.body: Preserve the current model-facing boundary and require a current-main restart/writeback repro before changing the allowlist.

options.title: Allow defaults and per-agent limits
options.body: Also permit the `agents.list[]` bootstrap limit overrides, accepting broader persistent config-write scope with explicit tests and proof.

recommendation.title: Allow only default bootstrap limits
recommendation.body: Permit the two `agents.defaults` bootstrap limit paths through the Gateway tool with focused guard tests and real restart/config-write proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is centered on Gateway config.patch/config.apply semantics, where this owner has recent merged history.
